guard_basis: Development M6D p27 recorded negative pose excursion11.7mm vs observed stationary drift<0.25mm; fixed rules, no validation tuning. Evidence of net pose motion required; not negative velocity alone.

guard_live.mode: same M6D warm service auto .15 release, new guard only; first emergency latched; no restart policy

interfaces.A: Frozen M6D auto throttle .15, brake .01, service hold .12
interfaces.B: fixed forward gear1, handbrake hold, throttle .15, brake .01
interfaces.C: official Ackermann, default server gains unchanged, speed profile acceleration magnitude .5 and jerk input1; no claim actual jerk enforcement

P1_condition: Only after development P0 all interfaces fail and attributable wheel-brake or transmission evidence exists. Freeze exactly one candidate and one family in separate config before any P1 trial. No further tuning. If P0 usable, P1 NotRun.
closed_loop_condition: All dynamics, guard and validation safety gates required; otherwise complete closed-loop matrix NotRun.
